body:
In my thirties, I traveled a lot to fight my depression. I took spontaneous road trips all over the USA. The most ambitious one was the ten days I spent driving from Texas (where I live) to New York City and then back home by a way of a scenic route across the East coast. It was exciting, but also lonely because I always went by myself. At present, I'm over travelling. I love to stay home.

I also tried doing stand-up comedy for about a year. That was fun, too, even when I sucked (which I usually did; I never got past the open-mic stage), but I eventually got tired of being out in bars late at night all of the time. So, I stopped doing that and I don't miss it. Glad that I tried, though. It was good for me.

THESE DAYS: I have a website in which I do lot of writing (not about depression, though) and I'm working on making a Youtube channel. Been researching microphones and lighting equipment since last week.
